About Crop PDF

Trim unwanted margins, cut a page down to one figure or table, or tidy uneven scan edges. Drag the area to keep and apply it to one page or all of them.

How it works

  1. 1Drop in the PDF and pick a page.
  2. 2Drag a rectangle over the area you want to keep.
  3. 3Apply to this page or every page, then save.

Common questions

Is the cropped-off part deleted?

The page is trimmed to the box you drew; the saved file shows only that area.

Can I crop different areas on different pages?

Yes — set the box on each page before saving, or apply one box to all.

Pages come out different sizes afterwards.

Run Resize Pages to make them uniform.
